title: Planner
shortDescription: A shared link on the phone that lets a group agree on when to come and what to do. Everyone votes on dates and activities, and the best plan rises to the top.
longDescription: Group visits often stall in endless chats about the date and the programme. It replaces that with one shared link: the organiser invites the group, each person ticks the days that work and the activities they want, such as an exhibition, a trail, games, or an AR experience, and the overview shows at a glance which day and which activities win. It runs in the browser on any phone, can be branded for the venue, and turns a vague maybe into a booked visit. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: From Group Chat to One Plan
highlights.description: Instead of dozens of messages, everyone ticks their days and favourite activities once, and the group instantly sees the best date and the most wanted programme.

highlights.title: The Visit Starts at Home
highlights.description: Visitors explore the offer while they plan, so the venue is on their mind days before they arrive and the programme they chose is ready when they do.

highlights.title: Easy to Sell to Any Venue
highlights.description: Museums, attractions, festivals, and company events all deal with group planning, which makes it a simple add-on for almost any client with a visitor programme.

highlights.title: Plans That Lead to Bookings
highlights.description: Add a ticket or booking link for the winning date, reminders before the visit, a group discount once enough people join, or a waiting list for popular slots.

highlights.title: A Plan for Every Group
highlights.description: Frame it as a family day out, a school class trip, a team offsite, or a festival crew picking which stages to see, each with its own look and activity list.

highlights.title: Know Who Is Coming
highlights.description: Add a data layer that shows planned group sizes, the most popular days, and the most wanted activities, so the venue can forecast attendance and staff accordingly.

highlights.title: From Plan to Programme
highlights.description: Pair with Journey Manager to turn the chosen activities into the group's route on the day, with Storytelling Invite to send a themed invitation, or with Visitor Identificator to greet each group member on arrival.
